purpose: Development-only explanation of task-dependent learning; no changes to trained models, checkpoint selection, primary comparison or confirmation protocol
probe_fit: linear logistic regression on standardized mean spike-trace features, L2 coefficient0.001, train labels only, fixed zero start, L-BFGS-B max200steps
gradient_development_examples: first32 from the128example registered development array, preserving the original dataset identity
directions: independent Gaussian55vectors normalized to unit Euclidean norm, all retained
gradient_comparison: paired plus/minus finite perturbation of actual hard-forward mean BCE against surrogate directional derivative; pair by RNGseed, report empirical MonteCarloSE and finite-step bias caveat
rnn_control: ordinary differentiable BPTT comparison; repeated deterministic samples have zero stochasticSE
trace_memory: report learned time constants, retention over0.75and1.25seconds, layer-specific count distribution and class-conditional trace means
inference_scope: descriptive mechanistic evidence only; no multiple-testing significance claim, confirmation access or hyperparameter selection
